verses.gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਚਰਨਨ ਰਜ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: kab laagai masatak charanan raj dharas dhiaa dhiragan kab dhekhau ||

en.bdb: When will my forehead be anointed with the holy dust of the feet of True Guru and when will I see the clement and merciful face of the True Guru with my own eyes?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਕਬ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਕਬ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਿਸੇਖਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat bachan sunau kab sravanan kab rasanaa benatee bisekhau ||

en.bdb: When will I hear the sweet ambrosial-like and elixir-giving words of my True Guru with my own ears? When will I be able to make a humble supplication of my distress with my own tongue before him?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਕਰ ਕਰਉ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਪਗਨ ਪਰਿਕ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਰੇਖਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: kab kar karau dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhanaa pagan parikramaadh pun rekhau ||

en.bdb: When will I be able to lie prostrate like a staff before my True Guru and salute him with folded hands? When will I be able to employ my feet in the circumambulation of my True Guru?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਛਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ॥ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਲੇਖਉ ॥੪੦੧॥
verses.translit_en: prem bhagat pratachh praanapat|| giaan dhiaan jeevan padh lekhau ||401||

en.bdb: True Guru who is the manifest of the Lord, provided of knowledge, contemplation, granter of salvation and sustainer of life when will I be able to realise Him clearly through my loving worship? (Bhai Gurdas Ii is expressing his pangs of separation from his True Guru)  (401)
